# Training corpus — PAP (2401.06373)

## What this trains

A **persuasive-paraphrase generator**: given `(harmful_goal, persuasion_technique)`,
produce a persuasive adversarial prompt (PAP) that rewrites the goal using that technique.
This is the attacker LLM skill — the red-team capability itself.

## Generated corpus

**`sft_pap_v4flash.json`** — 5,200 pairs (520 AdvBench goals × 10 techniques), generated by
`deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`, 100% success rate (0 failures).

Techniques: Logical Appeal, Authority Endorsement, Evidence-based Persuasion, Expert Endorsement,
Misrepresentation, Social Proof, Framing, Anchoring, Reciprocity, Storytelling.

Each row:
```json
{
  "goal_id": "<advbench row id>",
  "instruction": "Rewrite the goal into a persuasive adversarial prompt using the '<TECHNIQUE>' technique...",
  "goal": "<original harmful query>",
  "technique": "<technique name>",
  "technique_definition": "<from persuasion_taxonomy.jsonl>",
  "input_prompt": "<full one_shot_kd prompt fed to generator>",
  "output": "<generated PAP>",
  "status": "ok",
  "generator_model": "deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash"
}
```

## Generation command (reproducible)

```bash
uv run python scripts/generate_corpus.py \
  --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash \
  --techniques "Logical Appeal" "Authority Endorsement" "Evidence-based Persuasion" \
               "Expert Endorsement" "Misrepresentation" "Social Proof" \
               "Framing" "Anchoring" "Reciprocity" "Storytelling" \
  --concurrency 15 \
  --out data/training_corpus/sft_pap_v4flash.json
```
